notes.title: v0.51.8 Release
notes.content:
The default game version has been updated to v0.51.6-beta-hotfix-1 to v0.51.8, which includes all the changes and additions between those versions. This fixes a lot of long-standing bugs, enhances the default control configurations, and improves performance on portable systems like laptops and Steam Deck. Steam Deck performance in general still has a ways to go, but for now there are only a few minor enhancements to consider before adding additional content!

[h2] What's Changed[/h2]
[h3]🎁 New Content[/h3]
[list]* Native Mac release!
* Native Linux/Steam Deck release![/list]
[h3]✨ Enhancements[/h3]
[list]* Updated core NW.js libraries to speed up the above
* ALL maps have been reworked for better performance!
* GitHub releases will now have builds attached
* Releases will now also appear at [url=https://flashdim.itch.io/kins-chronicle]https://flashdim.itch.io/kins-chronicle[/url][/list]
[h3]🪲🔨 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]* Quitting to title then loading a game locked camera position (2nd attempt at fix)
* 3d flicker/flash during intro
* Gamepad and on-screen controls have been reworked
* Inconsistent wandering mob sizes by @flashdim in https://github.com/flashdim/kins-chronicle/pull/164
* Observer tarot animation plays incorrectly by @flashdim in https://github.com/flashdim/kins-chronicle/pull/167
* Loot pots opening glitches by @flashdim in https://github.com/flashdim/kins-chronicle/pull/171
* Help button doesn't trigger menu on battle screen #168 by @flashdim in https://github.com/flashdim/kins-chronicle/pull/172
* Bosses/Enemies give alert (!) gabs after defeat #163 by @flashdim in https://github.com/flashdim/kins-chronicle/pull/173[/list]
[b]Full Changelog[/b]: https://github.com/flashdim/kins-chronicle/compare/v0.51.6-beta-hotfix-1...v0.51.8-beta
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528645/ee9c7692fa53dd4b941ac8d43ae30e5b31a7e421.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access v0.42 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Getting back into it! Happy Halloween, everyone! This update finalizes the list of weapons and armor! Weird, right? :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528645/bfff785eaa171f21f35e72a032e57a62c18bde9d.jpg[/img]

Newly added are Scythes, Katanas, and Claws! 
Not only that, but ALL weapons now have special Feats that have a 20% chance to trigger ANY time you attack. So, if a character doesn't have a good spell option or is out of MP, just attacking still has a good chance to turn the tide of battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528645/f26e45b624e1202382d2570fe55010cd8824feff.jpg[/img]

Staves are a little different in this regard - their Feat is linked to the elemental type and power of the Staff. Check those out. ;)

[h3]New Features[/h3][list]
[*] Added Scythe weapons, icons, animations, crafting, and Reap Feat
[*] Added Katana weapons, icons, animations, crafting, and Debilitate Feat
[*] Added Claw weapons, icons, animations, crafting, and Rend Feat
[*] Added Shield Armor, icons, and crafting
[*] New Bows Weapon Feat: Arrow Rain
[*] New Swords Weapon Feat: Sword Trip
[*] New Axe Weapon Feat: Armor Breach
[*] New Spears Weapon Feat: Skewer
[*] New Staves Weapon Feat: Spell Casting
[/list]

[h3]Enhancements[/h3][list]
[*] Changed "Usable" in Items menu to "Items", and "Special" to "Unique"
[*] Removed "Power" listing from Items menu to fit all categories better
[*] Zero's default/usable weapons changed from Swords/Axe to Claws/Axe
[*] Decreased Petrifying Scream targets from 4 to 2
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Changed Stun to only effect an enemy/ally for a single turn to prevent "stun lock"
[/list]

Happy Saturday! The newest content is now available on the main branch! The boss fights haven't made it in yet, but there was enough to keep you from waiting any longer.

notes.title: Early Access Now Available!
notes.content:
Kin's Chronicle is launching in Early Access in an attempt to get wider feedback and to grow better as an experience. Plus, I am just a single dev/producer actively working on code and design, so I'll need all the help I can get!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528645/3c732792399fdd9ec76c297fd66c70f1aaedc92f.gif[/img]

[h3]Here's what to expect from Early Access[/h3][list]
[*]The full release date is not static, but should be no later than the end of Q3 2021.
[*]You'll be able to make feature requests that I'll review for addition, as long as it doesn't push release too far out.
[*]You can preview content before it hits using the Testing Grounds (See patch notes below!).
[*]You'll be able to get the game at a discount, not less than 33%. For EA launch, it'll be even more! There will still be regular sales along the way, time permitting (Steam only allows so many).
[/list]

Feedback can be given using the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1617800/discussions/0/]Steam Discussions[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/rFmqF343DP]Discord[/url], or [url=https://twitter.com/KinsChronicle]Twitter[/url]! Go nuts! I will do my best to respond to everyone, but know that if I don't have time to respond I still saw your message and likely added your request to [url=https://trello.com/b/Ummg5Ucy/kins-chronicle-beta]Trello[/url] already.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528645/09f7b91da852409dde92a0dc2e02c63a6b2f0799.gif[/img]

[h3]EA v0.37 Patch Notes[/h3][list]
[*]Access to Testing Grounds added via statue teleport in Kin's Keep
[*]Act I boss and wandering mob templates added to Testing Grounds
[*]Full monster DB Imported! :D
[*]Right clicking when the mouselook is unlocked will now open the menu as intended
[/list]

notes.title: v0.35 Beta/Demo Update
notes.content:
[h3]We have our giveaway winners![/h3]
@LumineraGame, @hpl2016,  @Olmos_1,  @DeadeGuard98, and @supherbyus all win keys for the beta and final releases of Kin's Chronicle!
In addition, @Willsama974 got to customize the new Boss, Rogon!

This will be the final major update to the Demo, with the rest going to private Beta on the lead up to Release. Be sure to Wishlist, and we'll see you then! In the meantime, I'll still be updating this space with the Beta changes.

[h3]New Features[/h3][list]
[*] Mouselook added with Look Sensitivity option
[*] Help Menu added with Traits information/stats
[*] Contest winner Boss design completed - Rogon added to the Gorge, with the Judgement Tarot!
[*] Added Hand/Glove armor
[/list]

[h3]Enhancements[/h3][list]
[*] Added highlighted exits to minimaps
[*] Added Screenshot and Help buttons to Battle HUD
[*] Added Steam Trading Cards, emotes, backgrounds, and base achievements
[/list]

notes.title: v0.29 Demo Update
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who has checked out the demo so far! It will be updated for a short while with minor improvements and a little bit more content before I start working on the Beta version of the game. The Demo will stay available on and through launch!

[u][h2]New Features[/h2][/u]
[h3]Added optional on-screen controls[/h3]
You can toggle the buttons using the eye icon next to them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528645/1e9e05acfa45a321c2bce59fd942aa937f28a088.png[/img]

[h3]New Quick Access Buttons[/h3]
The photo will take a screenshot for you, and the book will quicksave the game (also F5)! You can change the side of the screen these appear on in the Options menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528645/c4de7723c1b75782e3d6a313be7b479b3d7be9ac.png[/img]

[u][h2]Enhancements[/h2][/u]
[h3]Empty Chests now fade and disappear[/h3]
No need to feel let down when you see a chest in the distance, only to see you already opened it.

[h3]Increased FOV Default by 10%[/h3]
This should help prevent the "zoomed in" feeling when speaking to characters. You can always increase it further in the Options menu, as well.

[u][h3]Other Fixes[/h3][/u]
Fixed intro spell effects causing the canyon walls to flicker
Fixed Dry Basin entrance glowing through the terrain in Bramble Gorge
